========================================
#embed as the only initializer element
========================================

char d[]={
#embed "x" limit(5)
};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (array_declarator declarator: (identifier))
      value: (initializer_list
        (preproc_call directive: (preproc_directive) argument: (preproc_arg))))))

========================================
#embed between other initializer elements
========================================

char d[]={1,
#embed <x>
, 2};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (array_declarator declarator: (identifier))
      value: (initializer_list
        (number_literal)
        (preproc_call directive: (preproc_directive) argument: (preproc_arg))
        (number_literal)))))

========================================
Plain initializer lists still parse
========================================

int a[] = {1, 2, 3};
struct P p = {.x = 1, .y = 2};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (array_declarator declarator: (identifier))
      value: (initializer_list (number_literal) (number_literal) (number_literal))))
  (declaration
    type: (struct_specifier name: (type_identifier))
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      value: (initializer_list
        (initializer_pair designator: (field_designator (field_identifier)) value: (number_literal))
        (initializer_pair designator: (field_designator (field_identifier)) value: (number_literal))))))
